The '''Markbee's Star system''',<ref name="TEA" /> also known as the '''Zeffliffl system''',<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained [[Markbee's Star]], orbited by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeffliffl]]. This planet was occupied by a native [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Zeffliffl (species)|same name]].<ref name="TCS" />
